name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
benefit: Rs 6,000 per year in three equal installments of Rs 2,000, transferred directly to the farmer's bank account.
eligibility_rules: Must be a landholding farmer family (husband, wife and minor children) with cultivable land in their name
Land records must be in the farmer's name as per state land records
exclusions: Current or former holders of constitutional posts
Current or former ministers, MPs, MLAs, mayors, district panchayat chairpersons
Serving or retired government employees (except Group D / multi-tasking staff)
Persons who paid income tax in the last assessment year
Professionals like doctors, engineers, lawyers, CAs registered with professional bodies and practicing
Pensioners receiving Rs 10,000 or more per month (except Group D)
documents_required: Land ownership records (e.g. 7/12 extract in Maharashtra)
how_to_apply: Register online at pmkisan.gov.in or visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or local revenue officer (Patwari/Talathi).
